name: Armor
overview: Scripture presents armor both literally and figuratively as essential equipment for battle, emphasizing preparation and protection in spiritual and physical warfare. Jeremiah 46:3-4 describes the tangible gear of soldiers—bucklers, shields, helmets, spears, and brigandines—illustrating the seriousness of armed conflict. In the New Testament, believers are called to 'put on the whole armour of God' (Ephesians 6:11) to stand firm against spiritual adversaries, recognizing that the true battle is not against flesh and blood but against spiritual forces of darkness (Ephesians 6:12). Romans 13:12 urges Christians to cast off darkness and 'put on the armour of light,' highlighting the transformative power of Christ-centered living as protective and empowering.
